statement: All implementation files in this distribution were newly written for ResearchOps Toolkit. External projects and platform documentation were decomposed for design patterns; no upstream Skill, prompt, script, template, handbook, hook, or asset is vendored by default.
audit_limitations: Repository provenance declaration, not legal advice.
No claim of forensic similarity proof against every upstream revision.
